description: This Java class 'UpgradeDeviceFirmwareLegacyRequest' represents a device request to upgrade firmware on a Zigbee device. It contains fields for device identifiers and firmware filenames, and it executes the firmware upgrade by interacting with MockLegacySecurityDevice instances.

classes.name: UpgradeDeviceFirmwareLegacyRequest
classes.description: Represents a firmware upgrade request for legacy Zigbee devices, encapsulating necessary identifiers and executing the upgrade process.

methods.name: UpgradeDeviceFirmwareLegacyRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with device and firmware details.

methods.name: getAppFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the application firmware.

methods.name: getBootloaderFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the bootloader firmware.

methods.name: getAuthChallengeResponse
methods.description: Returns the authentication challenge response value.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by invoking the upgrade method on the device if it is a MockLegacySecurityDevice, and then sends a response.
